capabilities: scan vault notes for references to other note names or aliases
list found references for user review
create links between the selected notes
disambiguation: Not a backlinks viewer; it creates new links from unlinked mentions rather than showing existing links.
extras: The README advises backing up the vault before applying changes, saying the plugin has only been tested by the author and a few beta testers.
problem: Obsidian leaves unlinked mentions of note names in place, so users must find and link them manually.

relations.evidence: Created based on the Obsidian Rust Plugin template by trashhalo.
relations.plugin: Obsidian Rust Plugin template by trashhalo

summary: Link finder that scans the vault for mentions of other note names or aliases and lets you turn them into links.
